approach: Strict matching decompilation: a function counts only when its compiled and linked bytes equal the original exactly, with nothing masked.

notes: Work in progress on the game executable (EBOOT.BIN). The progress bar comes from the published objdiff report, which is generated from data/public-figures.json: the share of the public scope (the game's own code and the open-source libraries it links) that published sources reproduce byte for byte. Contains no game data, keys or decryption code; Sony SDK code the game links is not reconstructed here. You build and verify against your own copy of the game.
